name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Great, you made them!  These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes.  Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?

Here are your tickets, adventurer.  Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.

adventurer, can you make those leggings? If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward...
